thinking_toggleable.description: False when the model always reasons: a thinking switch would do nothing.

warning.description:
Why the action may be slow, when the runtime noted something (a Metal
load larger than the host memory macOS reports available).

error.description: Why the download failed, on an `error` event.

device_fit.description:
Whether the model can load on this device at all: `fits`,
`too_large` (it needs more memory than loads here are planned
against) or `unknown`. Other loaded models may still have to make
room for one that fits.

disk_required_bytes.description:
Free disk a download of the model needs: its files, plus the
checkpoint a `.nemo` archive unpacks on first load. 0 once
downloaded.

display_name.description: Human-readable model name from the catalog.

estimated_memory_bytes.description:
Memory the model needs to load, in bytes: the catalog's estimate,
which is all there is before the model is downloaded.

estimated_size_bytes.description: Expected download size from the catalog, for models not yet on disk.

memory_required_gb.description: Catalog estimate of memory needed to run the model, in GB.

pinned.description:
Explicitly loaded in this session: survives budget and memory-pressure
eviction until explicitly unloaded.

task.description:
Primary task: tts, asr, diarization, chat, forced_align, audio_chat
or tokenizer.

keyword_biasing.description: Transcription requests may bias recognition with `keywords`.

speaker_attributed_asr.description: Speaker-attributed ASR jobs: the model writes speaker turns itself.

speech_translation.description: Transcription requests may ask for a translation (`target_language`).

removed_models.description:
Downloads of variants whose support was removed, still on disk. They
are never deleted automatically; `DELETE /v1/admin/models/{variant}`
with the listed `variant` reclaims the space.

residency.description: Residency snapshot for the `ollama ps`-style observability surface.

AdminRemovedModelInfo.description: A leftover download of a removed variant.

replacement.description: The supported variant to use instead.

model_keep_alive_secs.description: Idle keep-alive for transient residents in seconds (0 = reaper off).

resident_count.description: Models currently tracked as resident (loading or ready).

controls.description:
Model-specific controls a speech request may set, each with its
range and the model's default (Chatterbox: `exaggeration`,
`cfg_weight`, `min_p`).

streaming_mode.description:
What a streaming request delivers on this server (TPIPE-3):
`chunked` (audio as the model commits it) or `unsupported`.

AdminStorageResponse.description: Where models are stored and how much room is left there.

free_bytes.description:
Free bytes on the volume holding the models; `None` when it cannot
be read.

alignment_source.description:
`model` when every word was timed by the aligner; `heuristic` when
some windows fell back to evenly spaced timings (see `warnings`).

duration.description: Duration of the aligned audio in seconds.

warnings.description: One entry per alignment window whose timings are not the model's.

skip_special_tokens.description: vLLM extension: `false` keeps special tokens in the reply text.

oneOf.description: Engine request phases; absent under strict OpenAI compatibility.

decode_ms.description: Sum of physical batch service time, not wall time.

decode_wall_ms.description: First entered decode dispatch registration to last durable token commit.

skip_special_tokens.description: vLLM extension: `false` keeps special tokens in the reply text.

allOf.description:
Model-specific sampling and controls (`top_p`, `seed`, `cfg_weight`,
`exaggeration`, `min_p`, ...); a control the model does not take is
refused.

SpeechSamplingRequest.description:
Optional speech-sampling fields a request may set beside `temperature`
and `top_k`. Anything left unset keeps the model family's reference
default (TPIPE-24): Qwen3-TTS generation_config, LFM 0.8 / top-k 64,
VibeVoice CFG 1.3 with 10 steps, fish-speech 0.7 / 0.7, Voxtral greedy.

cfg_weight.description:
Classifier-free guidance weight, in [0, 1]; 0 turns guidance off
(Chatterbox; its default is 0.5).

exaggeration.description: Emotion intensity, in [0, 2] (Chatterbox; its default is 0.5).

normalize_text.description:
Speak numbers, currency, dates, times and units as words (English).
Unset keeps the model's default: on for Kokoro, off for models that
read them themselves.

seed.description: Sampling seed (Qwen3-TTS, LFM2.5-Audio, Fish S2, Voxtral noise, Kokoro noise).

keywords.description:
Izwi extension: terms to bias recognition toward, as an array (or
one comma- or newline-separated string). Models without keyword
biasing reject it (400).

response_format.description:
One of json, verbose_json, text, srt, vtt; anything else (including
diarized_json) is rejected with 400 before transcription runs.

keywords.description:
Izwi extension: terms to bias recognition toward. Repeat the field or
separate terms with commas or newlines. Models without keyword
biasing reject it (400).

response_format.description:
One of json, verbose_json, text, srt, vtt; anything else (including
diarized_json) is rejected with 400 before transcription runs.

alignment_windows.description:
Aligner windows the audio was split into (each at most the aligner's
audio limit).

duration.description: Duration of the aligned audio in seconds.

izwi_asr_diagnostics.description:
ASR diagnostics. With word or segment timestamps it also carries
`alignment_source` (model, heuristic or failed), `alignment_warnings`
for windows timed by interval fallback, or `alignment_error`.
